verses.en: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.pt: Estas são as palavras do pacto que o Senhor ordenou a Moisés que fizesse com os filhos de Israel na terra de Moabe, além do pacto que fizera com eles em Horebe.
verses.en_web: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.en_bbe: These are the words of the agreement which Moses was ordered by the Lord to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the agreement which he made with them in Horeb.

verses.en: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.pt: Chamou, pois, Moisés a todo o Israel, e disse-lhes: Vistes tudo quanto o Senhor fez perante vossos olhos, na terra do Egito, a Faraó, a todos os seus servos e a toda a sua terra;
verses.en_web: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said in the hearing of all Israel, You have seen all the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his servants and all his land;

verses.en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.pt: as grandes provas que os teus olhos viram, os sinais e aquelas grandes maravilhas.
verses.en_web: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
verses.en_bbe: The great tests which your eyes saw, and the signs and wonders:

verses.en: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.pt: Mas até hoje o Senhor não vos tem dado um coração para entender, nem olhos para ver, nem ouvidos para ouvir.
verses.en_web: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
verses.en_bbe: But even to this day the Lord has not given you a mind open to knowledge, or seeing eyes or hearing ears.

verses.en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.pt: Quarenta anos vos fiz andar pelo deserto; não se envelheceu sobre vós a vossa roupa, nem o sapato no vosso pé.
verses.en_web: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your shoes have not grown old on your feet.
verses.en_bbe: For forty years I have been your guide through the waste land: your clothing has not become old on your backs, or your shoes on your feet.

verses.en: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.pt: Pão não comestes, vinho e bebida forte não bebestes; para que soubésseis que eu sou o Senhor vosso Deus.
verses.en_web: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink; that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: You have had no bread, or wine, or strong drink: so that you might see that I am the Lord your God.

verses.en: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.pt: Quando, pois, viemos a este lugar, Siom, rei de Hesbom, e Ogue, rei de Basã, nos saíram ao encontro, à peleja, e nós os ferimos;
verses.en_web: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us to battle, and we struck them.
verses.en_bbe: When you came to this place, Sihon, king of Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, came out to make war against us and we overcame them:

verses.en: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.pt: e lhes tomamos a terra, e a demos por herança aos rubenitas, aos gaditas e à meia tribo dos manassitas.
verses.en_web: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
verses.en_bbe: And we took their land and gave it to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, for their heritage.

verses.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.pt: Guardai, pois, as palavras deste pacto e cumpri-as, para que prospereis em tudo quanto fizerdes.
verses.en_web: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
verses.en_bbe: So keep the words of this agreement and do them, so that it may be well for you in everything you do.

verses.en: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
verses.pt: Vós todos estais hoje perante o Senhor vosso Deus: os vossos cabeças, as vossas tribos, os vossos anciãos e os vossos oficiais, a saber, todos os homens de Israel,
verses.en_web: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God; your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
verses.en_bbe: You have come here today, all of you, before the Lord your God; the heads of your tribes, the overseers, and those who are in authority over you, with all the men of Israel,

verses.en: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
verses.pt: os vossos pequeninos, as vossas mulheres, e o estrangeiro que está no meio do vosso arraial, tanto o rachador da vossa lenha como o tirador da vossa água;
verses.en_web: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water;
verses.en_bbe: And your little ones, your wives, and the men of other lands who are with you in your tents, down to the wood-cutter and the servant who gets water for you:

verses.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:
verses.pt: para entrardes no pacto do Senhor vosso Deus, e no seu juramento que o Senhor vosso Deus hoje faz convosco;
verses.en_web: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today;
verses.en_bbe: With the purpose of taking part in the agreement of the Lord your God, and his oath which he makes with you today:

verses.en: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.pt: para que hoje vos estabeleça por seu povo, e ele vos seja por Deus, como vos disse e como prometeu com juramento a vossos pais, a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó.
verses.en_web: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you, and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: And so that he may make you his people today, and be your God, as he has said to you, and as he made an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.en: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.pt: Ora, não é somente convosco que faço este pacto e este juramento,
verses.en_web: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,
verses.en_bbe: And not with you only do I make this agreement and this oath;

verses.en: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
verses.pt: mas é com aquele que hoje está aqui conosco perante o Senhor nosso Deus, e também com aquele que hoje não está aqui conosco
verses.en_web: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today
verses.en_bbe: But with everyone who is here with us today before the Lord our God, as well as with those who are not here:

verses.en: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
verses.pt: (porque vós sabeis como habitamos na terra do Egito, e como passamos pelo meio das nações, pelas quais passastes;
verses.en_web: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;
verses.en_bbe: (For you have in mind how we were living in the land of Egypt; and how we came through all the nations which were on your way;

verses.en: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
verses.pt: e vistes as suas abominações, os seus ídolos de pau e de pedra, de prata e de ouro, que havia entre elas);
verses.en_web: and you have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them);
verses.en_bbe: And you have seen their disgusting doings, and the images of wood and stone and silver and gold which were among them:)

verses.en: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.pt: para que entre vós não haja homem, nem mulher, nem família, nem tribo, cujo coração hoje se desvie do Senhor nosso Deus, e vá servir aos deuses dessas nações; para que entre vós não haja raiz que produza veneno e fel,
verses.en_web: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;
verses.en_bbe: So that there may not be among you any man or woman or family or tribe whose heart is turned away from the Lord our God today, to go after other gods and give them worship; or any root among you whose fruit is poison and bitter sorrow;

verses.en: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.pt: e aconteça que alguém, ouvindo as palavras deste juramento, se abençoe no seu coração, dizendo: Terei paz, ainda que ande na teimosia do meu coração para acrescentar à sede a bebedeira.
verses.en_web: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to destroy the moist with the dry.”
verses.en_bbe: If such a man, hearing the words of this oath, takes comfort in the thought that he will have peace even if he goes on in the pride of his heart, taking whatever chance may give him:

verses.en: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.pt: O Senhor não lhe quererá perdoar, pelo contrário fumegará contra esse homem a ira do Senhor, e o seu zelo, e toda maldição escrita neste livro pousará sobre ele, e o Senhor lhe apagará o nome de debaixo do céu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will have no mercy on him, but the wrath of the Lord will be burning against that man, and all the curses recorded in this book will be waiting for him, and the Lord will take away his name completely from the earth.

verses.en: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.pt: Assim o Senhor o separará para mal, dentre todas as tribos de Israel, conforme todas as maldições do pacto escrito no livro desta lei.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that is written in this book of the law.
verses.en_bbe: He will be marked out by the Lord, from all the tribes of Israel, for an evil fate, in keeping with all the curses of the agreement recorded in this book of the law.

verses.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;
verses.pt: Pelo que a geração vindoura - os vossos filhos que se levantarem depois de vós - e o estrangeiro que vier de terras remotas dirão, ao verem as pragas desta terra, e as suas doenças, com que o Senhor a terá afligido,
verses.en_web: The generation to come, your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land, will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which Yahweh has made it sick;
verses.en_bbe: And future generations, your children coming after you, and travellers from far countries, will say, when they see the punishments of that land and the diseases which the Lord has sent on it;

verses.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.pt: e que toda a sua terra é enxofre e sal e abrasamento, de sorte que não será semeada, e nada produzirá, nem nela crescerá erva alguma, assim como foi a destruição de Sodoma e de Gomorra, de Admá e de Zeboim, que o Senhor destruiu na sua ira e no seu furor;
verses.en_web: and that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath;
verses.en_bbe: And that all the land is a salt and smoking waste, not planted or giving fruit or clothed with grass, but wasted like Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, on which the Lord sent destruction in the heat of his wrath:

verses.en: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
verses.pt: sim, todas as nações dirão: Por que fez o Senhor assim com esta terra? Que significa o furor de tamanha ira?
verses.en_web: even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done thus to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
verses.en_bbe: Truly all the nations will say, Why has the Lord done so to this land? what is the reason for this great and burning wrath?

verses.en: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.pt: Então se dirá: Porquanto deixaram o pacto do Senhor, o Deus de seus pais, que tinha feito com eles, quando os tirou da terra do Egito;
verses.en_web: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,
verses.en_bbe: Then men will say, Because they gave up the agreement of the Lord, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he took them out of the land of Egypt:

verses.en: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
verses.pt: e se foram e serviram a outros deuses, e os adoraram; deuses que eles não tinham conhecido, e que lhes não foram dados;
verses.en_web: and went and served other gods, and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know, and that he had not given to them.
verses.en_bbe: And they went after other gods and gave them worship, gods who were strange to them, and whom he had not given them:

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.pt: por isso é que a ira do Senhor se acendeu contra esta terra, para trazer sobre ela toda maldição que está escrita neste livro;
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.
verses.en_bbe: And so the wrath of the Lord was moved against this land, to send on it all the curse recorded in this book:

verses.en: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
verses.pt: e o Senhor os arrancou da sua terra com ira, com furor e com grande indignação, e os lançou em outra terra, como neste dia se vê.
verses.en_web: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”
verses.en_bbe: Rooting them out of their land, in the heat of his wrath and passion, and driving them out into another land, as at this day.

verses.en: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.pt: As coisas encobertas pertencem ao Senhor nosso Deus, mas as reveladas nos pertencem a nós e a nossos filhos para sempre, para que observemos todas as palavras desta lei.
verses.en_web: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.en_bbe: The secret things are the Lord our God's: but the things which have been made clear are ours and our children's for ever, so that we may do all the words of this law.
